items.title: Nick Polites Interview, 1963-10-08
items.q: It's a, a sort of, uh, a hot Clarence Williams type of, uh, sound.

ctx.x: Oh, I'd like to hear it.
Um. Ah, I can't describe that sound. It's a, a sort of, uh, a hot Clarence Williams type of, uh, sound. Mm-hmm. And it was, uh, good while it lasted. They didn't keep it up for long.
Well, the Dees bands, uh, have many original tunes, like, uh, well, the Aztec Prentice is one I think of. You remember that?
